subject: maths
prompt_en: Add the 3rd and 4th triangular numbers, 6 and 10. What kind of number do you get?
prompt_hi: 3rd aur 4th triangular numbers, 6 aur 10, ko jodo. Kis tarah ka number milta hai?
answer: 16, a square number (4 × 4)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Describe a dot picture that shows 10 + 15 = 25 using two triangles.
prompt_hi: Do triangles se ek dot picture batao jo dikhaye ki 10 + 15 = 25.
answer: A triangle with rows 1 to 4 (10 dots) and a triangle with rows 1 to 5 (15 dots) fit together along a diagonal into a 5 by 5 square

subject: maths
prompt_en: Up and down: what is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1? What kind of number is it?
prompt_hi: Upar aur neeche: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 kitna hai? Yeh kis tarah ka number hai?
answer: 25, a square number (5 × 5)

subject: maths
prompt_en: My working: 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25, a square, because odd numbers add to squares. Spot the mistake.
prompt_hi: Meri working: 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25, ek square, kyunki odd numbers jodne se square banta hai. Galti dhoondo.
answer: 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 is 24, not 25, and it is not a square; the sum must start at 1

subject: maths
prompt_en: Mark points on a circle and join every pair. 2 points cut it into 2 pieces, 3 points into 4, 4 points into 8, 5 points into 16. Predict the number of pieces for 6 points.
prompt_hi: Circle pe points lagao aur har pair ko line se jodo. 2 points se 2 tukde, 3 se 4, 4 se 8, 5 se 16. 6 points ke liye kitne tukde guess karoge?
answer: 31 at most, not 32: the doubling pattern breaks

subject: maths
prompt_en: At a wedding, chairs are set in rows: 1 chair in the front row, 3 in the next, 5 in the next, and so on. With 12 rows, how many chairs are there?
prompt_hi: Ek shaadi mein kursiyan rows mein lagi hain: aage ki row mein 1, uske peeche 3, phir 5, aise hi. 12 rows hon toh kul kitni kursiyan?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Explain to a friend why checking three examples is not enough to be sure a pattern is always true, and what you can do instead.
prompt_hi: Dost ko samjhao ki 3 examples check karna kaafi kyon nahi hai yeh pakka karne ke liye ki pattern hamesha sahi hai, aur iski jagah kya kar sakte hain.
answer: Examples can fit a pattern that later breaks (circle pieces 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, then 31); a picture or reason that works for every step, like the L-shapes, shows it is always true

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What is the sum of the first 7 odd numbers?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Pehle 7 odd numbers ka total?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do two triangular numbers that are next to each other always make a square?
prompt_hi: Do lagataar triangular numbers milkar hamesha square kyon banate hain?
answer: The bigger triangle has rows 1 to n and the smaller has rows 1 to n−1; turned around, the smaller fits into the gap of the bigger, and every row becomes n long, making an n by n square

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 and 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1. Which gives a triangular number and which gives a square?
prompt_hi: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 aur 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 ko compare karo. Kaunsa triangular number deta hai aur kaunsa square?
answer: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10 is triangular; going up and back down gives 16, a square

subject: maths
prompt_en: 4 friends each shake hands with every other friend once. Draw 4 points and join every pair. How many handshakes?
prompt_hi: 4 dost har doosre dost se ek baar haath milate hain. 4 points banao aur har pair ko jodo. Kitne handshakes?

subject: maths
prompt_en: 5 points give 10 lines. Predict how many lines for 6 points.
prompt_hi: 5 points se 10 lines banti hain. 6 points ke liye kitni lines guess karoge?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does adding a 6th point add exactly 5 new lines?
prompt_hi: 6th point jodne se theek 5 nayi lines kyon banti hain?
answer: The new point joins each of the 5 old points once, and the old lines do not change

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square and a rhombus both have 4 equal sides. Which is a regular polygon, and why?
prompt_hi: Square aur rhombus dono ki 4 barabar sides hain. Inme se regular polygon kaunsa hai, aur kyon?
answer: The square: a regular polygon needs equal sides AND equal angles; a rhombus that is not a square has unequal angles

subject: maths
prompt_en: A big triangle is built from small triangles: 1 row gives 1, 2 rows give 4, 3 rows give 9. How many small triangles with 4 rows?
prompt_hi: Ek bada triangle chhote triangles se banta hai: 1 row se 1, 2 rows se 4, 3 rows se 9. 4 rows mein kitne chhote triangles?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Koch snowflake sides go 3, 12, 48. Say the rule in words, then give the next number.
prompt_hi: Koch snowflake ki sides 3, 12, 48 jaati hain. Rule shabdon mein batao, phir agla number.
answer: Multiply by 4 each time (every side becomes 4 sides); next is 192

subject: maths
prompt_en: My working: snowflake sides go 3, 12, 21, 30, adding 9 each time. Check me.
prompt_hi: Meri working: snowflake ki sides 3, 12, 21, 30, har baar 9 jodkar. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: each side becomes 4 sides, so it multiplies by 4: 3, 12, 48, 192

subject: maths
prompt_en: In a cricket tournament, 8 teams each play every other team once. How many matches are there?
prompt_hi: Ek cricket tournament mein 8 teams hain, har team baaki har team se ek baar khelti hai. Kitne matches honge?

subject: maths
prompt_en: 7 points on a circle, every pair joined. How many lines?
prompt_hi: Circle pe 7 points, har pair joda. Kitni lines?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how the joining-points pattern is connected to triangular numbers.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao ki points-jodne wala pattern triangular numbers se kaise juda hai.
answer: Each new point adds as many lines as there are old points: 0, then +1, +2, +3, +4, so the totals 0, 1, 3, 6, 10 are triangular numbers

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! How many sides does a regular octagon have?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Regular octagon ki kitni sides hoti hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Kabir counted lines for 4 points like this: each point has 3 lines, 4 × 3 = 12 lines. What went wrong?
prompt_hi: Kabir ne 4 points ki lines aise gini: har point se 3 lines, 4 × 3 = 12. Galti kya hui?
answer: Each line was counted twice, once from each end; 12 ÷ 2 = 6

subject: maths
prompt_en: The edge of your ruler from one end to the other: is it a line segment, a line or a ray?
prompt_hi: Tumhare ruler ka kinara ek sire se doosre sire tak: line segment, line ya ray?
answer: A line segment

subject: maths
prompt_en: How is a line segment different from a line?
prompt_hi: Line segment aur line mein kya fark hai?
answer: A segment has two endpoints and a fixed length; a line has no endpoints and goes on forever in both directions

subject: maths
prompt_en: Ray PQ: which point does it start from?
prompt_hi: Ray PQ kis point se shuru hoti hai?
answer: P

subject: maths
prompt_en: I said ray AB and ray BA are the same ray. Am I right?
prompt_hi: Maine kaha ray AB aur ray BA ek hi ray hain. Kya main sahi hoon?
answer: No: ray AB starts at A and goes through B; ray BA starts at B and goes the opposite way

subject: maths
prompt_en: Line XY is drawn 3 cm long on paper. Rahul draws line XY again, 10 cm long. Predict: is his a longer line?
prompt_hi: Line XY kaagaz pe 3 cm lambi banayi hai. Rahul line XY phir se 10 cm lambi banata hai. Guess karo: kya uski line lambi hai?
answer: No, it is the same line; a line goes on forever, and the drawing shows only part of it

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why can't we measure the length of a line, but we can measure a line segment?
prompt_hi: Line ki lambai kyon nahi naap sakte, par line segment ki naap sakte hain?
answer: A line has no endpoints and goes on forever, so it has no fixed length; a segment has two endpoints, so its length is fixed

subject: maths
prompt_en: Three points A, B, C are not on one straight line. How many line segments can join them in pairs? Name them.
prompt_hi: 3 points A, B, C ek seedhi line pe nahi hain. Inhe pairs mein jodne se kitne line segments bante hain? Naam batao.
answer: 3: AB, BC and CA

subject: maths
prompt_en: Four villages, no three in a straight line, are each joined by a straight road to every other village. How many roads?
prompt_hi: Chaar gaon hain, koi teen ek seedhi line mein nahi. Har gaon har doosre gaon se seedhi sadak se juda hai. Kitni sadakein?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Describe how you would draw ray MN. Where do the dot and the arrow go?
prompt_hi: Batao ray MN kaise banaoge. Dot kahan lagega aur arrow kahan?
answer: A dot at M, a line through N, and an arrow beyond N; only M is an endpoint

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach Chintu the difference between a line segment, a line and a ray, using a pencil, a never-ending railway track, and sunlight.
prompt_hi: Chintu ko pencil, kabhi na khatam hone wali railway track, aur dhoop ki kiran ka example dekar segment, line aur ray ka fark sikhao.
answer: A pencil has two ends, like a segment; a never-ending track goes both ways forever, like a line; sunlight starts at the sun and goes one way forever, like a ray

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! How many endpoints does a ray have?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Ray ke kitne endpoints hote hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Diya drew a ray with a dot at both ends. What did she get wrong?
prompt_hi: Diya ne ek ray banayi jiske dono sire pe dot hain. Usne kya galat kiya?
answer: A ray has only one endpoint; the other side needs an arrow. With two dots it is a segment

subject: maths
prompt_en: You open a door a little, then wide open. Which makes the bigger angle?
prompt_hi: Darwaza thoda kholo, phir poora kholo. Kisme bada angle banta hai?
answer: Wide open: it has turned more

subject: maths
prompt_en: Two angles both open like clock hands at 3 o'clock: one has 2 cm arms, the other 10 cm arms. Predict which is bigger.
prompt_hi: Dono angles 3 baje wali ghadi ki suiyon jitne khule hain: ek ki arms 2 cm, doosre ki 10 cm. Guess karo kaunsa bada hai.
answer: Neither; they are equal, both a quarter turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why doesn't making the arms longer make an angle bigger?
prompt_hi: Arms lambi karne se angle bada kyon nahi hota?
answer: An angle measures the turn between the arms; extending the arms does not change their directions, so the turn stays the same

subject: maths
prompt_en: Scissors opened a little and scissors opened a lot. Which angle is bigger, and what changed?
prompt_hi: Kainchi thodi khuli aur kainchi zyada khuli. Kaunsa angle bada hai, aur kya badla?
answer: Opened a lot is bigger; the amount of turn between the blades changed

subject: maths
prompt_en: Rani drew a narrow angle with very long arms and a wide angle with short arms. She says the long-armed one is bigger. Is she right?
prompt_hi: Rani ne ek patla angle lambi arms ke saath aur ek chauda angle chhoti arms ke saath banaya. Woh kehti hai lambi arms wala bada hai. Kya woh sahi hai?
answer: No, the wide one is bigger; arm length does not matter, only the turn

subject: maths
prompt_en: The hands of a clock at 3 o'clock and at 6 o'clock. At which time is the angle between the hands bigger?
prompt_hi: Ghadi ki suiyan 3 baje aur 6 baje. Kis time pe suiyon ke beech ka angle bada hai?
answer: 6 o'clock: a half turn is bigger than a quarter turn
